changeSet.author: eop
changeSet.comment: Remove the six placeholder cards from 002-seed-placeholder-deck. They must go before the real deck lands: uq_card_suit_rank is unique on (suit, card_rank), and every placeholder occupies a coordinate the real deck also uses, so inserting over them would violate the constraint. Deleted by identifier rather than by a blanket DELETE so the changeset cannot silently discard data it did not create.

rollback.comment: Rolling back re-inserts nothing: 002-seed-placeholder-deck owns those rows and rolling this changeset back is only meaningful alongside rolling that one forward again.

changeSet.author: eop
changeSet.comment: All 78 cards, ordered by suit then rank. Aces read "You've invented a new <Suit> attack": they are Open Threat cards, and EOP-14 must treat them as requiring a threat not printed on any other card rather than as ordinary high cards.
